title: Pricing Rules
description: Automate price adjustments by segment or product.

help.title: About Pricing Rules
help.overview: Pricing rules change the unit price before a discount code is applied. Each cart line receives at most one rule. Name, type, value, and what it applies to are required.

sections.title: Which rule wins
sections.body: Active rules are ordered by priority, highest first, then newest. The first rule that matches the line is applied. Later rules on that line are skipped.
items: A rule with no customer groups applies to every cart. A rule that lists groups applies only when the signed-in customer is in one of them. Guests match only rules with no groups.
Applies to all, or to customer group, hits every line. Product, category, and collection hit only the selected targets. Category uses the product's first category.
Minimum order amount uses the cart subtotal before any rule. Minimum quantity uses the total number of units. A rule outside its start and end is ignored.

sections.title: What the types do
sections.body: The adjustment is applied to the catalog unit price. The result is never below zero.
items: Percentage discount reduces the unit price by that percent.
Fixed discount subtracts the value from the unit price.
Fixed price replaces the unit price with the value.
Surcharge adds the value to the unit price.
